## What it is

The ring that drops onto the four bar ends. The pockets match the plugs, and the centre hole is Ø63.4 mm.

## Design notes

- Each pocket is 18.4 × 10.2 mm with the same tooth as the ring slot.
- The hoop stays inboard of the mouths, so the tube still presses in from outside with the cap on.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't enlarge the hoop out to the bar. That would close the mouths.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: same hoop. It sits at 117.6 mm above the ring instead of 113.6 mm.
